requirement: Ranked category-browsed directory of external resources
notes: Spec §39.1–39.2. Community-curated links (archives, Discord servers, author platforms, writing tools) ranked by user votes. Planned in docs/plans/junior-implementation-plan.md §15e.

requirement: Submission with operator review queue
notes: Spec §39.3. Signed-in submission, operator approval gate (configurable), pending invisible to strangers. Planned in §15e.

requirement: One-vote-per-account toggle voting with denormalised score
notes: Spec §39.4. Vote in same transaction as score recompute; weightless by design. Planned in §15e.

requirement: URL validation refusing non-http(s) and private addresses
notes: Spec §39.3. SSRF posture shared with webhook verifier. Planned in §15e.

requirement: Operator-configurable categories via TOML
notes: Spec §39.2, §38. Seed categories + [directory].extra_categories. Planned in §15e.

requirement: Fork action: empty draft with lineage edge gated by statements/registry/depth
notes: Spec §40.1. One-click fork; copies tags not bodies; Remixes list on parent. Planned in §15f.

requirement: Permission statements editable per work with effective-sentence UI
notes: Spec §40.2, §33.1. Six statements (podfic/translation/remix/continuation/redistribution/ai_training), yes|ask|no|unstated, owner-only edits, audited. Planned in §15f.

requirement: Statement enforcement at fork/translation/narration doors
notes: Spec §40.2. Each refusal names the statement. Planned in §15f.

requirement: Half-life job writing half_life_bp as silent ranking multiplier
notes: Spec §41.1. Nightly job on reading_events; basis points; silent-reordering contract §16.3. Planned in §15g.

requirement: Warmth accumulation hooks with config-driven tier thresholds
notes: Spec §41.2. Reading/reacting/commenting accumulate warmth_bp between account pairs. Planned in §15g.

requirement: Author-facing aggregate tier panel with no per-reader exposure
notes: Spec §41.2–41.3. Aggregate counts only; no reader-facing surface anywhere. Planned in §15g.

requirement: Shared sort vocabulary with for-you default on every browse surface
notes: Spec §43.2. sort= for-you|new|updated|top|trending|best-match|az.

requirement: For-you ordering is a permutation never a filter
notes: Spec §43.3. Identical reachable sets across sorts; pagination reaches every eligible item.

requirement: Per-pseud sticky sort preference with an anonymous neutral default
notes: Spec §43.4. Neutral on undeclared/private-topic instances.

requirement: Per-surface diversity budget and exposure measurement
Exact and literal queries exempt from taste steering
notes: Spec §43.2, §15.10. Carried forward unchanged.

requirement: Multiple taste sources with a 5-member k-anonymity floor
notes: Spec §16.15. admin|cohort|roles|combined; startup refuses a small cohort.

requirement: Reason fields degrade to one undifferentiated line below public topics
notes: Spec §16.16, §0.4.3. Stops the ordering channel leaking the theme.

requirement: Contribution term computed only from the permitted metric list
notes: Spec §16.16.1. Quality composite (§9.7.4), half-life (§41.1), delivered positive feedback, new-to-instance supply, curatorial labour; never volume, tenure or spend.

requirement: Alignment modulates weight and never adds recognition
notes: Spec §16.16. Leaderboards and badges earned from quality signals alone.

requirement: Demand weight as trust x taste x contribution with a config switch
notes: Spec §16.16. Reuses domain::vote_weight (M39); [weighting].mode flat|trust|trust_taste|trust_taste_contribution.

requirement: No weight exposure on any surface export or error message
notes: Spec §16.16.2, §39.6. Test asserts absence, the way §41.3 does.

requirement: Bounded taste floor and ceiling published on meta
notes: Spec §16.16.3. floor x ceiling below or equal 1 enforced at startup; both published on /api/v1/meta.

requirement: Majority-integrity guard routes weighted/unweighted disagreement to quorum
notes: Spec §16.16.3, §19.4. A weighted bloc cannot reverse a plain majority. Also applies to §39.4.

requirement: Demand diversity budget with a non-zero default
notes: Spec §16.16.3. Fraction of surfaced demand carrying no boost from any term.

requirement: Leaderboard categories reject volume metrics and all-time boards
notes: Spec §9.7.5, §28.10. No words written, posts, hours online; placements expire with the window.

requirement: No lifetime ladder exists and recognition never gates or governs
notes: Spec §1.5, §9.7.1, §0.3, §19.1. Asserted by test across every route and surface.
